description_en: Manages the endpoints and ports of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于管理实例的连接地址和端口
name: ModifyDBInstanceConnectionString

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The current endpoint of the instance. The endpoint can be an internal endpoint or public endpoint, or a classic network endpoint in hybrid access mode.
You cannot modify the read/write splitting endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
实例当前的某个连接地址，可以是内外网连接地址，或者混访模式下的经典网络连接地址。
不支持修改读写分离连接地址
parameters.name: current_connection_string

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the new endpoint. You can only modify the prefix of the CurrentConnectionString parameter.
The prefix must be 8 to 64 characters in length and cannot contain Chinese characters or invalid characters (such as ~!#%^&*=+\|{}:'",<>/?). We recommend that you use letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
目标连接地址的前缀，即只能修改CurrentConnectionString参数的前缀部分。
长度8~64，不能包含汉字和非法字符（~!#%^&*=+\|{};:'",<>/?），建议由字母、数字、短横线（-）组成
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The TDS port number for Babelfish for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL.
This parameter is only applicable to ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances. For more information about Babelfish for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html
parameters.help_zh:
Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL TDS端口号。
该参数仅适用于RDS PostgreSQL实例，Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL的更多介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html
parameters.name: babelfish_port

parameters.help_en: The name of the group to which the general-purpose instance in the dedicated cluster belongs
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群MySQL通用版实例所属的组名
parameters.name: general_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The PgBouncer port number.
This parameter is only applicable to ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances. You can modify the PgBouncer port number only if PgBouncer is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
PgBouncer端口号。
该参数仅适用于RDS PostgreSQL实例，如果开启了PgBouncer，则支持修改PgBouncer端口号
parameters.name: pg_bouncer_port

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the destination ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with which you want to swap endpoints.

This parameter is only supported for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
parameters.help_zh:
需要交换连接地址的目标RDS PostgreSQL实例ID。

该参数仅支持RDS PostgreSQL实例
parameters.name: target_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the virtual IP address (VIP) when swapping endpoints.

true: Retains the VIP.
false (default): Does not retain the VIP.

This parameter is only supported for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
parameters.help_zh:
交换连接地址时是否保留虚拟IP地址（VIP）。

true：保留VIP。
false（默认值）：不保留VIP。

该参数仅支持RDS PostgreSQL实例
parameters.name: retain_vip
